actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The chimera makes one Ram attack, one Bite attack, and one Claw attack. It can replace the Claw attack with a use of Fire Breath if available.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +7, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage, or 18 (4d6 + 4) Piercing damage if the chimera had Advantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +7, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Ram
actions.text: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +7, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 10 (1d12 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: _Dexterity Saving Throw:_ DC 15, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. _Failure:_ 31 (7d8) Fire damage. _Success:_ Half damage. ## Chuul
